summary: Syrop attempted to move a ceasefire resolution at Hayward's Dec 5, 2023 council meeting and, after the mayor cut him off, urged activists to keep pressing the body. He co-signed a January 2024 letter demanding a durable ceasefire and voted to divest the city's $1.6M in Caterpillar, Chevron, Hyundai, and Intel shares. In May 2024 he called the divestment 'about ending genocide.' CAIR Action endorsed his campaign; Vote for Peace rates him an Ally.
